issues.issue: Parking charges are not recreation (pool, park, golf, recreation) fees. They belong in charges for services/fees, as the Parking detail line detail[147] already has them.
Under the user's 2026-10-28 rule, utility fund charges go in Utility Charges. The Sewer detail line (detail[159]) already uses Utility Charges, so receipts and detail disagree.

Rent/rental income has its own receipt category, Rentals (user 2026-10-28). detail_category is already 'rentals', but the category was left as charges for services/fees. The 'Rents, royalties and other' detail lines (detail[69], detail[92], detail[123]) have the same mismatch.

issues.on_page: Parking Facilities Fund: Personal services 1,408,483; Employer pension 351,932; Employer OPEB 136,091; Outside services 7,789,004; Operation and maintenance 2,287,389; Depreciation and amortization 3,038,485 (detail[150]-detail[155])
issues.issue: Business-type spending printed by cost type takes the cost type as category (user 2026-10-28): Salaries and Wages, Employee Benefits and Payroll Taxes, Professional/Contract Services, Repairs and Maintenance, Depreciation. The Sewer lines follow this; the six Parking lines sit in 'other' even though specific categories fit.

These are also printed by cost type. Under the 2026-10-28 rule the category would be the cost type (with function), not culture/recreation. This is inconsistent with the Sewer detail and the statement-level disbursements.

issues.on_page: Charges for services - Citywide Sports and tennis 1,199,283; Marinas 480,867
issues.issue: Sports, tennis and marina charges are recreation fees. The user's Recreation Fees category (used for Golf, receipts[16]) fits better. Same for receipts[15].
The line's own review note says the dominant category is rentals, but the category is charges for services/fees. Rentals (with review for the mix) would match the note.

issues.on_page: State Turn Back Revenue Fund: Intergovernmental 526,531
issues.issue: The whole fund is state turnback revenue, and Turnback is the user's own receipt category (never state aid). The printed label is only 'Intergovernmental', so this is a judgment call.

issues.on_page: Street and Highway Allocation Fund: Contributions and grants 1,496,205
issues.issue: Street fund grants are probably from a government, not private donors. This is the same open question as the statement-level Contributions and grants in decision_needed. The same applies to Storm Water (detail[105]), Household Chemical Disposal (detail[137]) and Debt Service (detail[187]) contributions and grants.

issues.on_page: Public works/interceptor division 37,928 (Interceptor Sewer Construction Fund)
issues.issue: Sewer interceptor work is a sewer (utilities) function. Storm-water flood control (detail[107], 2,212,329) is also in health/welfare, where natural resources/conservation or utilities may fit better.

The label says debt service, and the GAAP statement shows General Fund principal 7,741,752 + interest 5,642,060. 'debt service (principal and interest combined)' may fit better than general government. The line already carries review. Street and Highway 'Debt service (other accounts)' 100,968 (detail[75]) has the same issue.
